description: Renovate opens pull requests that merge themselves once CI passes for dev dependencies' minor and patch updates and for the workflows' actions, zizmor, typos and Bun, and pull requests that wait for a person for pnpm/setup and lockfile maintenance. The polyfill folder's packages open one pull request that waits for a person. Everything else waits on the Dependency Dashboard: peers of @sohedra/lynx and their dev copies, Lynx, majors, runtime dependencies, pnpm, Node.js. svelte-without-renderers never updates. Security fixes keep Renovate's default: they open a pull request at once, whatever the rule; only a dev dependency's merges itself.

dependencyDashboard.header:
This issue lists Renovate updates and detected dependencies. Read the [Dependency Dashboard](https://docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/dashboard/) docs to learn more.

An entry for a peer of `@sohedra/lynx` is a signal to widen its peer range by hand; never approve it.

prBodyNotes: If a dependency of `@sohedra/lynx` moved, run the phone check before merging.

customManagers.description: zizmor, which CI runs with pipx, not as an action.
typos, the spelling check CI runs with pipx, not as an action.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates of dev dependencies open a pull request that merges itself once CI passes.
The workflows' actions, zizmor, typos, and Bun (read from pnpm/setup's runtime input) update in one pull request that merges itself once CI passes, except a major.
The repository allows pnpm/setup at one commit only, so its update fails CI until a person allows the new commit.
prBodyNotes: Before this can pass CI, allow the new commit of pnpm/setup in Settings > Actions > General and in `ALLOWED` of `scripts/workflows.ts`, in place of the old one.

packageRules.description: Each peer of @sohedra/lynx and its dev copy wait on the dashboard, so a dev copy never moves past its peer range. Their entries are a signal to widen the peer by hand and are never approved. scripts/renovate.ts keeps this list equal to the peers.

The npm packages @sohedra/lynx bundles into every app's polyfills update in one pull request that waits for a person: the vendored modules are bundled again and the web platform tests run on both PrimJS builds before it merges. Pinned exactly.
prBodyNotes: Run `pnpm -F @sohedra/lynx vendor` and commit the vendored modules, then the web platform tests on both PrimJS builds and the phone check, before merging.

packageRules.description: rstest's coverage plugin moves with @rstest/core, which waits as a peer.
Tailwind CSS 4 is not supported (support policy S8).
Lynx packages wait on the dashboard as one entry; Lynx moves by hand, one version at a time, with the engine-upgrade checklist.
svelte-without-renderers is a Svelte from before custom renderers (5.58.0), which the setup check's test installs.
engines.node follows the support policy, by hand.
